namespace: removed flat location; selected tuple/control detail remains local
type: UI-schema element or registered detail name
default: not applicable globally; tuple positions use their normal generated/registered detail
effect: none from flat config; a local detail controls tuple position layout and selected editors
precedence: flat config ignored; authored control or selected cell/position detail is resolved at its own scope

type: object containing width, height, maximizable, draggable and resizable
default: native dialog geometry and interaction defaults
effect: display and interaction; supplies form-wide dialog dimensions and window controls
precedence: selected cell/row/tuple dialog properties override global members individually, including false; unrelated members retain global defaults

type: positive number or safe CSS dimension
effect: display only; sets detail dialog width
precedence: local dialog.width > namespaced dialog.width > built-in default

type: positive number or safe CSS dimension
effect: display only; sets detail dialog height
precedence: local dialog.height > namespaced dialog.height > built-in default

effect: display only; permits maximizing a detail dialog
precedence: local dialog.maximizable > namespaced dialog.maximizable > built-in default

effect: display only; permits pointer dragging of a detail dialog
precedence: local dialog.draggable > namespaced dialog.draggable > built-in default

effect: display only; permits resizing of a detail dialog
precedence: local dialog.resizable > namespaced dialog.resizable > built-in default
